module: Stores and rereads the default spawn point chosen for each level. The data is stored in settings/cloud/game-state.json (key levels[levelName].defaultSpawnPointName, plus lastLevelName). It is used by spawn.pickSpawnPoint and by the level selection menu.
notes: In setDefaultSP, 'levelName:lower() or core_levels.getLevelName(...)' can never use the fallback: if levelName is nil, the :lower() call already raises an error. levelName must always be provided.
In loadDefaultSpawnpoint, the error message uses 'levelname' (lowercase, nonexistent variable) instead of 'levelName': it always displays 'nil'.
loadDefaultSpawnpoint always returns a string (empty '' if nothing) and not nil: an 'if result then' test is therefore always true (see spawn.pickSpawnPoint).
The file's logTag is 'spawn.lua' (copied from spawn.lua), so the logs appear under that name.

settingsFilePath.desc: Path of the JSON save file: 'settings/cloud/game-state.json'.

getLastLevelName.desc: Reads lastLevelName from the save file.

returns.desc: Name of the last level recorded by setDefaultSP, nil if absent.

loadDefaultSpawnpoint.desc: Returns the name of the level's default spawn point: the one recorded by the user if it is in the spawnPoints list of the level's info file and exists in the scene, otherwise defaultSpawnPointName from the level's info file, otherwise ''.

levelName.desc: Level name (current level by default, via core_levels.getLevelName(getMissionFilename())).

returns.desc: Name (editor name) of the spawn point, or ''; also '' if the level's info file is unreadable.

setDefaultSP.desc: Records in settings/cloud/game-state.json the default spawn point for a level and remembers this level as the last level. Logs a warning if the write fails.

defaultSPName.desc: Name (editor name) of the spawn point.
